desc_teleportation: Moves one of your pieces to any empty square, ignoring obstacles.
desc_imune: Makes one of your pieces (not the king) invulnerable during the opponent's next turn.
desc_rollback: Sends one of your pieces (not the king) back to the square it came from, if it is free.
desc_clone: Copies one of your pieces (not the king) onto an adjacent empty square.
desc_morph: Turns a piece into another one: one turn if it is an enemy piece, two otherwise.
desc_canceller: Cancels the effect of an enemy skill used on the previous turn.
desc_tornado: Rotates every piece on the board in one direction, except the kings. A pawn is never promoted.
desc_invisibility: Makes one of your pieces invisible for two turns.
desc_freeze: Prevents an enemy piece (not the king) from moving for two of its turns.
desc_terminator: Copies a random enemy piece, with its abilities, onto your side for one turn.
desc_destiny_swapper: Swaps the positions of two of your pieces.
desc_trap: Sets a trap on an empty square: the first enemy piece to pass over it is immobilized for two turns.
desc_bench: Puts a piece on the bench for one turn; it comes back on the nearest free square.
desc_forcefield: If the protected piece is captured, the attacker is pushed back by up to two squares.
desc_transposition: Swaps the position of two pieces, without causing a check.
desc_queensac: On checkmate, swaps the queen and the king; the queen dies in the king's place.
desc_temporal: An allied piece goes back in time to the square it came from (capture allowed), instead of your move.
desc_geomancy: Moves squares to raise walls that block the opponent for three turns.
desc_celestial: Once per game, prevents an allied piece from being captured and puts it back on its starting square.
desc_godhelp: A random piece with random abilities appears for three turns.
desc_remover: Removes an enemy pawn from the board, unless that causes a checkmate.
desc_wall: Brings pawns back to life as a protective wall, playable from the next turn.
desc_mirage: Simulates a piece on the board (not the king); it vanishes if it is captured.
desc_evolve: Evolves a piece as if it had crossed an enemy evolution square.
desc_switch: Makes an enemy piece out of range and out of line of sight change sides.
desc_mind: Gives the best possible move, three times per game.
desc_control: Takes control of an enemy piece for a full turn (not the king).
